shortDescription: By Vivek Kumar MShares of the National Stock Exchange of India (NSEI.BO) rose nearly 1% on their trading debut on Thursday, capping a decade-long effort to list the country's largest bourse.The stock opened at 1,800 rupees on the BSE, 0.84% above its IPO price of 1,785 rupees.

children: Shares of the National Stock Exchange of India (NSEI.BO) rose nearly 1% on their trading debut on Thursday, capping a decade-long effort to list the country's largest bourse.
The stock opened at 1,800 rupees on the BSE, 0.84% above its IPO price of 1,785 rupees.
